en: Black‑and‑white illustrated postcard showing a soldier with a rifle standing on rocky ground, looking out over a body of water with islands or coastline in the distance. Another smaller figure stands further away near the shore. At the top there is printed Swedish text about proceeds for a hometown hospital in Uddevalla, and across the image there is a handwritten date, most likely from 1915. An artist's signature appears in the lower right corner.
